applicability: -N dB beamwidth computed from a supplied horizontal polar measurement against a declared coverage target

equations.beamwidth_deg: positive_crossing_deg - negative_crossing_deg, where each crossing is the linearly-interpolated angle at on_axis_db-threshold_db

assumptions: the supplied polar samples are absolute (not peak-normalized) levels at a consistent measurement distance and reference
linear interpolation between adjacent measured angles approximates the true continuous pattern
excluded: pattern-asymmetry detection beyond the two reported crossings
uncertainty: Standard, widely-used loudspeaker/microphone-array directivity specification found on commercial datasheets; hand-verified before use with a synthetic symmetric cosine-like pattern (on-axis 90 dB, -6 dB crossings at +/-54.545 degrees -> beamwidth=109.09 degrees).
limits_policy: A beamwidth exceeding the declared coverage target is flagged rather than accepted.
